title: Observe Python agents without tool wrappers
changes: Connect existing Python scripts through a startup launcher without editing individual tool functions; remove monitoring by restoring the original command.
Capture default SQLite and urllib activity, plus installed synchronous Requests and HTTPX calls, with payload minimization and bounded capture.
Evaluate observed calls against console policies after execution and label launcher connections as observation-only even under blocking policies.
Updated connection journey, public developer guide, console screenshot and runnable example with explicit coverage and evidence limits.

title: Connected agent reliability and versioned downloads
changes: Monitor connected agents in a searchable table with run-status filters and counted problems and coverage gaps.
Develop and test detection checks with optional coding models; retain saved-run regression tests.
Inspect reported multi-agent trajectories and compare agent versions on shared cases.
Download 68 instrumented agent packs with explicit outcomes, tool graphs and a fixture comparison helper.
Read the public Developer Guide and updated walkthrough; download immutable versions from Releases.
